name: Glycohemoglobin (HbA1c %)
clinical_utility: Gold standard diagnostic & monitoring marker for diabetes; robust to non-fasting status.

name: Fasting Serum Glucose (mg/dL)
clinical_utility: Diagnostic for impaired fasting glucose / diabetes, but restricted to morning fasting subsample (~54% missing in adults).

name: Total Cholesterol (mg/dL)
clinical_utility: Key cardiovascular risk predictor; available across full examined cohort (only ~18% missing).

name: Direct HDL-Cholesterol (mg/dL)
clinical_utility: Cardioprotective lipid fraction; essential for Framingham, SCORE, and metabolic syndrome calculation.

name: Serum Triglycerides (mg/dL)
clinical_utility: Atherogenic marker and metabolic syndrome criterion; measured in fasting subsample (~52% missing).

name: Friedewald LDL-Cholesterol (mg/dL)
clinical_utility: Primary target of lipid-lowering therapy; calculated in fasting subsample.

name: Serum Creatinine (mg/dL)
clinical_utility: Essential for estimating GFR (eGFR) and staging chronic kidney disease / cardiorenal syndrome.

name: Blood Urea Nitrogen (mg/dL)
clinical_utility: Marker of renal clearance, hydration status, and heart failure severity.

name: Serum Uric Acid (mg/dL)
clinical_utility: Biomarker for gout, metabolic syndrome, and endothelial dysfunction.

name: Alanine Aminotransferase ALT (U/L)
clinical_utility: Indicator of hepatocellular injury and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD).

name: Aspartate Aminotransferase AST (U/L)
clinical_utility: Indicator of hepatic and myocardial cellular integrity; AST/ALT ratio.

name: Alkaline Phosphatase (U/L)
clinical_utility: Biliary/bone marker; low specificity for primary cardiometabolic risk.

name: Total Bilirubin (mg/dL)
clinical_utility: Liver excretion marker; rarely abnormal in early cardiometabolic disease.

name: Serum Albumin (g/dL)
clinical_utility: Marker of nutritional status, hepatic synthesis, and systemic inflammatory response.

name: Serum Sodium (mmol/L)
clinical_utility: Electrolyte balance; tightly regulated, high noise for general risk.

name: Serum Potassium (mmol/L)
clinical_utility: Electrolyte; critical in acute settings, less predictive in chronic risk classification.

name: Hemoglobin (g/dL)
clinical_utility: Anemia detection; anemia strongly exacerbates cardiovascular strain and mortality.

name: White Blood Cell Count (1000 cells/uL)
clinical_utility: Non-specific systemic inflammation marker strongly correlated with atherogenesis and CAD.

name: Platelet Count (1000 cells/uL)
clinical_utility: Thrombotic potential and bone marrow/liver dysfunction indicator.

name: Red Cell Distribution Width (%)
clinical_utility: High RDW is an established independent predictor of all-cause and cardiovascular mortality.
